entries.subject: HR Systems Team Meeting - tomorrow
entries.body:
Hello!

 

It’s our team meeting tomorrow, and it’s Presentations week.

 

Please let me know if you have something you’d like to share with the team.

 

See you tomorrow!

 

Best wishes,

Asta
entries.ai_note: Asta Palmer reminds Kevin that the HR Systems Team meeting is tomorrow during Presentations week and requests notification if Kevin has something to present.

entries.subject: RE: PDR 2026 – Friday 18 September
entries.body:
Hi Kevin,

I’m on leave on 18 September and the following week. With the annual leave year-end also approaching, would it be possible to push this back to the week commencing 12 October, when we know everything will be out of the way?


Best wishes,
Michael

Michael O’Sullivan
Senior Functional Analyst

HR Systems |People Department
4 Worcester Street, Oxford, OX1 2BX
University of Oxford

Whatfix – use our self-help tool for PeopleXD
A-Z PeopleXD guidance 

Find us online | Contact the team


-----Original Message-----
From: Kevin Lelitte <kevin.lelitte@admin.ox.ac.uk> 
Sent: 25 August 2026 13:17
To: Michael O'Sullivan <michael.osullivan@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: PDR 2026 – Friday 18 September

Hi Michael,

It’s that time again — I’ve scheduled your 2026 PDR for Friday 18 September, 12:00–1:00pm, replacing our usual 1-to-1 that day.

As we’ve been through the process before, I won’t go into as much detail as last year. Ahead of our meeting, please complete a new PDR form and send it back to me beforehand so I have a chance to review it.

I’ve attached a blank review form and also included your 2025 PDR, which may be useful when looking back at last year’s discussion, progress and objectives.

As before, a few bullet points are absolutely fine. The important thing is that we have a useful conversation about how things have gone over the past year, what’s gone well, anything you’d like to discuss, and what you’d like to focus on over the coming year.

If there are any problems with the date, just let me know.

Best,
Kevin
entries.ai_note: Michael O'Sullivan is unavailable on 18 September and the following week and asks Kevin to reschedule the PDR meeting.
